mapper.select: SELECT id, title, content, is_pinned AS pinned, created_at, updated_at FROM notices WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY is_pinned DESC, created_at DESC
SELECT id, title, content, is_pinned AS pinned, created_at, updated_at FROM notices WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT id, question, answer, sort_order FROM faqs WHERE is_published = 1 ORDER BY sort_order, id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notices (title, content, is_pinned, author_id) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{pinned}, #{authorId})
